title: "Tu Agar Pairaway Sajjad Nahi Ho Sakta"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Manqabat"
poet: "Yasir"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false

1
Tu Agar Pairaway Sajjad Nahi Ho Sakta.
Zulm Ki Qaid Se Aazad Nahi Ho sakta.
Ishq-e-Abid Se Hai Aabad Agar Dill Tera.
Phir Yeh Likh Le Khe Tu Barbad Nahi Ho sakta.

2
Aal-e-Ahmad Ki Musibat Pe Jo Khush Hota Hai.
Zindagi Bhar Woh Kabhi Shad Nahi Ho sakta.
Jo Lagata Nahi Mula Ke Waseelay Se Sada.
Woh Bashar Qabil-e-Imdad Nahi Ho sakta.

3
Jo Ke Ab Narah-e-Haider Ke Muqabil Aaye.
Aisa Narah Kabhi Ejad Nahi Ho sakta.
:SIBT-E-JAFAR: Ki Tarha Mulk-e-Adab Mein Yasir
Ab Koi Dosra Ustad Nahi Ho sakta.

roman = '\\n'.join(line.removeprefix('  ') for line in meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines())
for edition, numerals in ((roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')):
    stanzas = [s.splitlines() for s in edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
    assert [s[0] for s in stanzas] == list(numerals)
    assert [len(s) - 1 for s in stanzas] == [4, 4, 4]
assert 'direction: \"rtl\"' in meta and 'noUrdu' not in meta
print('Verified both editions contain three matching four-verse stanzas.')

Reconstructed the Urdu body and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Both editions contain three matching four-verse stanzas. I set the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, kept the Roman title as `alternateTitle`, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.
